title: PET scan
description: A PET (positron emission tomography) scan visualizes metabolic activity in your body to detect cancer, heart disease, or neurological conditions. During this outpatient test, you receive a small injection of radioactive tracer that accumulates in areas with abnormal metabolic activity. After waiting 30-60 minutes, you lie in the PET scanner for 20-30 minutes. Results show exactly where disease is present and how active it is. This information guides diagnosis, treatment planning, and monitoring. You go home the same day with no side effects from the minimal radiation exposure.
